bio.text: Manny De Los Santos represents Assembly District 72.

According to his official biography, he was raised in Northern Manhattan, attended public schools, and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology and a master's degree in social work from the University at Albany (SUNY).
He worked for 13 years as a social worker and community school director in New York City public schools and is a member of Community Board 12.
